liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-17.173413.mtx.seamons.ht179.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-04-17.145264.nak.senn..blend.ackerman.miller.noel.t-flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min [2]
- **gd1984-04-17.141837.NAK.Blend.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min [3]
- **gd1984-04-17.149173.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 158 min [6]
- **gd1984-04-17.neumann-u87.eaton.miller.90543.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [17]. Said about its sound: Reviewer really likes the sound quality of this recording [44]
- **gd1984-04-17.fob.at-nak300.jtjames.96460.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [18]. Said about its sound: Recording is big and booming, requiring subwoofer for full impact; Sound is nice, bright, and loud; Phil's bass shook shelves [33][41]
- **gd1984-04-17.109346.beyer-senn.daweez.D5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [25]. Said about its sound: Recording rocks, with Franklin's Tower noted as very nice [36]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first show; audience from southern Ontario attended for 25th anniversary [34]
- Attendee traveled from SUNY Buffalo, dancing continuously as band played tightly [35]
- Weir ran offstage near end of jam; Jerry continued the performance [40]
- Odd venue with riser; reviewer moved front for second set [40]
- Band struggled slightly with Row Jimmy but maintained high energy [41]
- Second set opener sequence blew reviewer's mind; epic stumble into Slipknot [42]
- Venue resembled airplane hangar; people climbed the giant arch before show [43]
- Jerry's voice improved during show; band tied the house together [43]
- Encore version was faster paced than later performances [34]

- **gd1984-04-17.173413.mtx.seamons.ht179.flac1644**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) August 17, 2025 [1]
